events.title: Bybit heist

research.summary: Attackers stole approximately $1.5 billion in virtual assets from Bybit after compromising a signing workflow associated with an external multisignature service.
research.significance: The incident became the largest publicly reported crypto theft to that point and a defining modern exchange-security failure.

sources.title: FBI — North Korea Responsible for $1.5 Billion Bybit Hack
Bybit — Security Incident Timeline

events.title: US Strategic Bitcoin Reserve established

research.summary: A US executive order established a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve capitalized initially with finally forfeited government BTC and directed that Bitcoin deposited into the reserve not be sold.
research.significance: The policy transformed confiscated Bitcoin from an asset normally disposed of by government into a formally designated reserve category.

sources.title: White House — Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and Digital Asset Stockpile Executive Order
White House — Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Fact Sheet

events.title: Ethereum Pectra upgrade

research.summary: Ethereum activated the Prague-Electra (Pectra) upgrade at epoch 364,032.
research.significance: Pectra combined major validator, wallet and Layer-2-scaling improvements and was Ethereum's largest bundle of EIPs to that point.

sources.title: Ethereum.org — Pectra
Ethereum Foundation — Pectra Mainnet Announcement

events.title: Ethereum Fusaka upgrade

research.summary: Ethereum activated the Fulu-Osaka (Fusaka) upgrade at epoch 411,392.
research.significance: Fusaka advanced Ethereum's data-availability and Layer-2 scaling roadmap while also increasing Layer-1 performance capacity.

sources.title: Ethereum.org — Fusaka
Ethereum Foundation — Fusaka Mainnet Announcement

events.title: El Salvador changes Bitcoin legal-tender requirements under an IMF-backed program

research.summary: El Salvador's legislature approved amendments to the Bitcoin Law that removed mandatory acceptance and other essential legal-tender features, making private-sector Bitcoin acceptance voluntary as part of reforms linked to an IMF-supported program.
research.significance: The amendment materially scaled back the compulsory elements of the world's first national Bitcoin legal-tender regime while leaving Bitcoin lawful to use.

sources.title: IMF — El Salvador EFF Staff Report
Reuters — El Salvador lawmakers reform Bitcoin law

events.title: US government establishes a Digital Asset Stockpile alongside the Bitcoin Reserve

research.summary: The same executive order established a separate United States Digital Asset Stockpile for finally forfeited digital assets other than Bitcoin.
research.significance: The policy explicitly separated Bitcoin reserve treatment from stewardship of other government-held crypto assets.

sources.title: White House — Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and Digital Asset Stockpile Executive Order
White House — Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Fact Sheet

events.title: Stablecoin legislation becomes a major US federal policy milestone

research.summary: The US President signed S. 1582, the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act (GENIUS Act), into law.
research.significance: The law created a federal statutory framework for payment stablecoins, marking a major shift from agency-led enforcement and state-by-state rules toward national legislation.

sources.title: White House — GENIUS Act Signed Into Law

events.title: Corporate Bitcoin treasury strategies expand beyond early adopters

research.summary: Reuters reported that at least 61 non-crypto-focused public companies had adopted Bitcoin treasury strategies by mid-June 2025, with their collective holdings roughly doubling over two months.
research.significance: The Strategy/MicroStrategy model had evolved from an unusual corporate treasury decision into a broader public-markets financing strategy.

sources.title: Reuters — Bitcoin treasury strategies in public markets

events.title: Bybit resumes withdrawals rapidly after hack

research.summary: Bybit said all pending withdrawals had been processed and normal withdrawal operations restored within roughly 12 hours; a subsequent proof-of-reserves review said in-scope customer assets were again backed at least 1:1 within 72 hours.
research.significance: The rapid liquidity response became an unusual contrast to exchange hacks that turned into insolvency or withdrawal freezes.

sources.title: Bybit — Security Incident Timeline
Bybit — Fully Backed Within 72 Hours

events.title: Lazarus Group attribution becomes central to Bybit investigation

research.summary: The FBI publicly attributed the Bybit theft to North Korea, calling the activity TraderTraitor and warning that the stolen assets were being rapidly converted and dispersed across blockchains.
research.significance: The attribution made the heist a major state-linked cybercrime event and reinforced North Korea's central role in crypto theft.

sources.title: FBI — North Korea Responsible for $1.5 Billion Bybit Hack

events.title: Pectra raises Ethereum maximum effective validator balance

research.summary: Pectra raised Ethereum's maximum effective validator balance from 32 ETH to 2,048 ETH while retaining 32 ETH as the minimum.
research.significance: The change allowed large validators to consolidate infrastructure and earn rewards on balances above the old 32 ETH cap.

sources.title: Ethereum.org — Pectra
Ethereum Foundation — Pectra Mainnet Announcement

events.title: Pectra adds account-abstraction-style wallet functionality

research.summary: Pectra's EIP-7702 allowed externally owned Ethereum accounts to temporarily gain smart-contract functionality such as transaction batching, fee sponsorship and enhanced recovery patterns.
research.significance: The feature was a major step toward account-abstraction-style wallet UX without forcing users to migrate to new account addresses.

sources.title: Ethereum.org — Pectra
Ethereum Foundation — Pectra Mainnet Announcement

events.title: Fusaka advances Ethereum data-availability scaling

research.summary: Fusaka introduced PeerDAS, allowing nodes to sample portions of blob data rather than each node downloading every blob, with later blob-parameter-only forks planned to raise throughput further.
research.significance: PeerDAS materially expanded Ethereum's potential rollup data capacity while aiming to preserve accessible node operation.

sources.title: Ethereum.org — Fusaka
Ethereum Foundation — Fusaka Mainnet Announcement

events.title: Tokenized Treasury funds exceed major market milestones

research.summary: BlackRock's tokenized BUIDL fund surpassed $1 billion in assets under management.
research.significance: The milestone was a major proof point that public-blockchain tokenized Treasury/cash products had moved from experiment to billion-dollar institutional scale.

sources.title: Securitize — BUIDL Surpasses $1B AUM

events.title: Stablecoin payments become a major fintech competition theme

research.summary: Major payment networks accelerated stablecoin integration during 2025: Mastercard announced end-to-end wallet, card, merchant-settlement and remittance capabilities, while Visa expanded stablecoin-linked cards and multi-stablecoin settlement support.
research.significance: Stablecoins increasingly shifted from exchange settlement assets toward mainstream payment-network infrastructure.

research.summary: Major banks and payment networks expanded work on tokenized deposits, stablecoin settlement and programmable payment infrastructure during 2025.
research.significance: The line between bank deposits, tokenized bank money and regulated stablecoins became increasingly important to institutional payments strategy.

events.title: US federal crypto policy shifts toward strategic-reserve framework

research.summary: US federal digital-asset policy shifted toward a strategic-reserve framework during 2025, with the March 6 executive order as the clearest canonical milestone.
research.significance: Use the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve event rather than this umbrella trend when scoring cards.

sources.title: White House — Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and Digital Asset Stockpile Executive Order

events.title: US agencies reassess earlier crypto banking restrictions

research.summary: US banking regulators rolled back several earlier crypto-specific supervisory hurdles: the OCC removed its prior non-objection process on March 7, the FDIC rescinded its prior-notification requirement on March 28, and the Federal Reserve withdrew earlier crypto/dollar-token guidance on April 24.
research.significance: The sequence materially changed the regulatory posture for banks considering permissible crypto, custody, stablecoin and distributed-ledger activities.

sources.title: OCC — Clarifies Bank Authority for Crypto Activities
FDIC — Banks May Engage in Permissible Crypto Activities Without Prior Approval

events.title: Major US banks expand crypto custody and trading exploration

research.summary: As regulators clarified bank authority, the OCC confirmed national banks could provide crypto custody and customer-directed execution services, while major banks such as Citi publicly explored custody and stablecoin payment offerings.
research.significance: Traditional banks moved closer to directly providing crypto infrastructure instead of participating only through experiments or investments.

research.significance: Tokenization was no longer limited to pilot projects; regulated investment products were operating at institutional scale.

events.title: Public companies raise capital specifically to accumulate Bitcoin

research.summary: Some public companies raised equity or debt specifically to acquire additional Bitcoin rather than merely allocating existing cash balances.
research.significance: This financing model turned Bitcoin accumulation into an explicit capital-markets strategy and increased both upside exposure and balance-sheet risk.

events.title: Bitcoin-backed corporate financing structures become a distinct market theme

research.summary: Convertible debt, equity issuance and other financing structures tied to Bitcoin-treasury accumulation became a distinct public-market theme.
research.significance: The trend extended the Strategy playbook from treasury management into recurring capital formation centered on acquiring more Bitcoin.
